summary: Dawson Group (dawson.com.au) is a Cootamundra-based chartered accounting and advisory firm, in business since 1918, with offices in Goulburn, Narooma and Yass after a late-2024 merger with a Yass firm. It has been a Xero Gold Champion partner since 2012, works with Figured, and sells outsourced bookkeeping with a promise that the client's bank account balances every month. Andrew Loveridge joined as Director/Partner in 2024 after about 20 years in business banking at NAB and is based in Goulburn. This is a strong fit: multi-office, Xero-centred, bookkeeping-led.

hooks.text: Outsourced bookkeeping promising a balanced bank account every month, now delivered across four offices after the Yass merger: reconciliation consistency is the operational challenge.
Andrew's 20 years in business banking means he judges numbers by lender-grade traceability; an audit trail angle fits, and Dawson is hiring a credit analyst for debt advisory.
Xero Gold Champion since 2012 plus Figured: Vert slots into an existing Xero workflow rather than replacing it.

risks.text: Tim Meares, not Andrew, is the director responsible for outsourcing services, so Andrew may forward the email; Tim is not a contact on record.
Two earlier emails (16 and 23 Nov) have gone to Andrew without a recorded reply; a third nudge needs a clearly different angle.
Andrew is a recent career-changer from banking, so he may lean on his accounting directors for tooling decisions.

gaps: No podcast, YouTube, Facebook or Instagram content found for Andrew or the firm.
No posts by Andrew after the May 2025 announcement surfaced.
No mention of Dext, Hubdoc or any AI reconciliation tool found.
The account note that contact names were unverified is resolved: Andrew and Kate both appear on the firm's directors page.
